sentences.en: Though timid in some respects, he was very bold in others.
sentences.zh: 尽管在某些方面胆小，但他其他时候却非常勇敢。

sentences.en: Marc, whose spirit is timid, hid himself, fearing danger.
sentences.zh: 马克性格怯懦，害怕危险而躲了起来。

sentences.en: She seems timid, but she's actually a strong-willed person.
sentences.zh: 她看起来很胆小，但实际上是一个意志坚强的人。

senses.zh: 胆小的，不自信的lacking courage, self-confidence

mnemonic: 词根记忆：tim（害怕）+id（…的）→胆小的
